domain_label: INBDE Content & FMG Pathway — Clinical Content Material Map + Resource Shelf (code dental)
purpose: A method for building the INBDE study-content map from the JCNDE Domain of Dentistry blueprint (the 10 Foundation Knowledge x 56 Clinical Content matrix) as far as the research could verify it, wiring the free/official resource shelf to that map, and carrying the honest completeness gap where the full verbatim 56-area Clinical Content enumeration could not be pulled — as a named [UNKNOWN] blocker (JCNDE PDFs render the CC areas as Figures 1-4 images/tables and every direct fetch returned HTTP 403 under session egress) — so a candidate can prioritize study without ever mistaking the partial reconstruction for the authoritative list or vouching quality for a merely-existing resource.
assumptions: no live fetch of the official JCNDE/ADA PDFs was available; the blueprint structure and CC/FK content were reconstructed from search-engine snippets of the official pages plus corroborating secondary aggregators, and every claim not confirmed against a directly-read official page is carried as [ESTIMATE] or [UNKNOWN]

the 56-area Clinical Content enumeration is the top verification backlog item, not a delivered artifact; the official document URLs are recorded so a downstream run with fetch access can extract them verbatim

resources are listed for EXISTENCE only; this map makes no claim about the accuracy, quality, or endorsement of any secondary/commercial resource, and several are commercial products with free content tiers
the INBDE is the knowledge exam only; the separate clinical (hands-on) ADEX/DLOSCE requirement is out of this content map's scope and is referenced only as a boundary
exclusions: the licensure PATHWAY mechanics (ECE credential evaluation, DENTPIN, ADEA CAAPID advanced-standing, state-board routing) beyond naming the knowledge-vs-clinical exam boundary — those belong to the pathway specialist KB

exam FORMAT and logistics (500 items over 2 days, timing, fees, retake interval, pass standard 75) beyond the diagnostic-feedback-by-FK/CC mechanic that drives remediation — those belong to the exam-mechanics KB
the clinical hands-on exam content (ADEX restorative/perio components, CompeDont manikins, DLOSCE stations) beyond flagging it as a separate non-INBDE requirement

inventing any CC area not corroborated by an official-page snippet, any FK-by-FK or CC-by-CC published item weight (none is published), or any named video series/YouTube channel that could not be verified

glossary.definition: Integrated National Board Dental Examination — the single computer-based national board knowledge exam required across US licensing jurisdictions, run by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations (JCNDE) under the ADA; launched August 2020, replacing NBDE Part I and Part II [FACT]. Knowledge exam only; does not satisfy the separate clinical exam requirement.

The official INBDE content matrix: 10 Foundation Knowledge (FK) areas x 56 Clinical Content (CC) areas [FACT]. Every item is written to integrate at least one FK area applied within a CC area, which is what the 'Integrated' in INBDE denotes. Defined in the JCNDE Item Development Guide and Model Domain of Dentistry PDFs.

One of the 10 basic-science/behavioral competency areas (development/structure/function; physics-chemistry of biology; physics-chemistry of materials; genetic/congenital/developmental disease; immune host defense; pathology; microbiology; pharmacology; behavioral sciences/ethics/jurisprudence; research methodology/informatics). Wording is [ESTIMATE — high confidence]; no official per-FK item weight is published.

One of the 56 patient-care task areas grouped into three component sections; each item applies FK knowledge within a CC area. The full verbatim 56-area list with official numbering is [UNKNOWN] here because the JCNDE PDFs render the areas as Figures 1-4 images and direct fetches returned HTTP 403.

A. Diagnosis and Treatment Planning (13 CC areas, ~36.2% of scored items); B. Oral Health Management (23 areas, ~42.0%); C. Practice and Profession (20 areas, ~21.8%). Counts and weights are [ESTIMATE]; the total 56 is [FACT]; counts (number of areas) and weights (share of scored items) describe different things and are not expected to reconcile.

The named blocker at the heart of this KB: the complete verbatim enumeration of all 56 CC areas with official numbering could not be extracted, because the JCNDE PDFs present them as Figures 1-4 (images/tables) and every direct fetch (jcnde.ada.org, ada.org, ece.org, university mirrors) returned HTTP 403 under session egress policy. It is the #1 verification follow-up.

The honesty label on the resource shelf: a resource is recorded because it demonstrably exists, with NO claim about its accuracy, quality, or endorsement; commercial products with free content tiers are flagged as such, and no unverifiable named video series is listed to avoid fabricating a source.

The provenance discipline inherited from the research file: a claim confirmed against a directly-read official page or an official-existence artifact is [FACT]; a claim reconstructed from official-page snippets or secondary corroboration is [ESTIMATE]; a claim that could not be verified (the 56 CC verbatim list, FK item weights, a free official practice test) is [UNKNOWN] with its blocker named — never replaced by an invented fact.

The remediation signal from the score report: passing candidates receive no numeric score, while failing candidates receive performance feedback broken out by FK and CC area [FACT]. Read against the blueprint, this feedback tells a re-taker which FK/CC cells to restudy.

The JCNDE-published document that defines the FK and CC areas and shows integrated-item construction (with Figures 1-4 carrying the CC enumeration and Appendices A-E). Official URL exists [FACT] but returned HTTP 403 under egress; it is the primary artifact a fetch-enabled run must open to close the enumeration gap.

nodes.definition: Establish the single organizing fact of the whole content map: the INBDE content blueprint is the JCNDE 'Domain of Dentistry' matrix of 10 Foundation Knowledge (FK) areas x 56 Clinical Content (CC) areas [FACT — confirmed across official-page snippets and Item Development Guide references]. This matrix, not a discipline outline, is what item-writers build to; it is why the exam is 'Integrated'. The blueprint is defined in the JCNDE Item Development Guide and the Model Domain of Dentistry PDFs (official URLs on jcnde.ada.org). Everything downstream — the FK set, the three CC groups, the resource shelf, and the honest enumeration gap — hangs off this matrix, so it is stated first and its 10x56 shape is the fixed frame the rest of the map fills in.

the blueprint-not-discipline-outline framing
the pointer to the Item Development Guide / Model Domain of Dentistry as its source

nodes.definition: Give the item-share weighting of the three CC groups and defuse the count-vs-weight confusion: group A Diagnosis and Treatment Planning ~36.2%, group B Oral Health Management ~42.0%, group C Practice and Profession ~21.8% of scored items [ESTIMATE — from official-page snippets plus secondary aggregators]. nodes.definition: State the mechanic that gives the exam its name and shapes how to study: every INBDE item is written to integrate at least one FK area applied within a CC area [FACT — this is what 'Integrated' in INBDE means]. A single case-based item can pull FK6 pathology, FK8 pharmacology and FK9 ethics into a group-B management CC task at once. The study consequence is that memorizing FK basic-science and CC clinical content in isolation under-prepares a candidate; the map must be read cell-wise (FK-in-CC), and case-based practice that forces the integration is the highest-value study mode. This principle links the FK rows and CC columns into the working unit of the exam.

the study consequence that siloed FK/CC memorization under-prepares
the case-based-practice-as-highest-value implication

pros.example: practicing a perio case that combines microbiology, pharmacology and management rather than three separate flashcard decks

failure_modes: studying FK basic-science and CC clinical content in isolation and missing the integration

nodes.definition: Carry the FK-side gap paired to the CC weight distribution: JCNDE does NOT publish a public fixed FK-by-FK item-weighting table [UNKNOWN — no official per-FK item percentages]. conflict_axes.description: The wish for a complete-looking artifact pulls toward inventing CC areas, FK weights, or a video series, against the discipline of naming the blocker.
poles: leave the slot empty with the blocker named
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: never invent an area/weight/channel; carry the [UNKNOWN] with its named blocker and the verification follow-up

conflict_axes.name: knowledge_map_vs_clinical_exam_scope
conflict_axes.description: The knowledge-content map can be misread as covering the separate clinical hands-on exam requirement.
poles: fold clinical-exam prep into the map
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the INBDE knowledge boundary and route ADEX/DLOSCE clinical content to the clinical/pathway specialists

conflict_axes.name: prioritization_grade_vs_authoritative_syllabus
conflict_axes.description: A usable prioritization scaffold can be over-claimed as an authoritative complete CC syllabus.
poles: ship it as an authoritative syllabus
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: issue GO for prioritization and NO-GO as an authoritative enumeration until the 56 CC areas are read verbatim

edge_cases.description: A downstream KB treats the partial per-group CC themes as the complete official 56-area list
edge_cases.trigger: the reconstructed themes are copied without their partial/[ESTIMATE] tags
edge_cases.mitigation: carry the [UNKNOWN] enumeration gap with every group list and forbid any claim that the partial reconstruction is the complete official 56

edge_cases.description: The 13/23/20 area counts are summed and expected to reconcile with the ~36/42/22 item-share weights
edge_cases.trigger: counts and weights are read as the same measure
edge_cases.mitigation: state that counts (number of areas) and weights (share of items) measure different things and are not expected to add up

edge_cases.description: A prevention/community item is treated as definitively in group C when it may officially sit in group B
edge_cases.trigger: a group label is taken as authoritative despite unverified membership
edge_cases.mitigation: flag the B-vs-C placement as unverified and confirm each area's section in a fetch-enabled read before relying on it

edge_cases.description: A reconstructed FK area title is quoted verbatim as official wording
edge_cases.trigger: the [ESTIMATE] tag on the FK wording is dropped in a summary
edge_cases.mitigation: keep the [ESTIMATE — verify Item Development Guide] tag on FK wording and mark it close-to-official, not verbatim

edge_cases.description: A secondary blog is cited as authoritative for a CC area's content
edge_cases.trigger: an existence-only listing is read as an endorsement
edge_cases.mitigation: cite the official blueprint documents for content and use secondary resources only as existence-flagged corroboration

edge_cases.description: A candidate assumes a free official full-length practice test exists and under-prepares
edge_cases.trigger: the practice-test [UNKNOWN] is read as a confirmed yes
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the Item Development Guide sample items as the confirmed official practice content and mark a standalone free official practice test [UNKNOWN] pending verification

edge_cases.description: An unverified YouTube 'INBDE video series' is added to the shelf by name
edge_cases.trigger: the empty video-series slot is filled to look complete
edge_cases.mitigation: leave the slot empty with the blocker named and add a named series only after fetch-verified reputability/officialness

edge_cases.description: The INBDE content map is used to prepare for the clinical hands-on (ADEX/DLOSCE) exam
edge_cases.mitigation: state INBDE is knowledge-only and route clinical-exam prep to the clinical/pathway specialists

edge_cases.description: A HTTP 403 on an official page is read as evidence the resource or CC areas do not exist
edge_cases.trigger: an egress-policy block is confused with non-existence
edge_cases.mitigation: record the official URLs as existing-but-403-blocked and route them to a fetch-enabled verification pass, never as non-existent

edge_cases.description: An FK-by-FK item-weight table is invented to parallel the CC-group weights
edge_cases.trigger: the absence of a published FK weighting is filled with a fabricated one
edge_cases.mitigation: state no official per-FK item weighting is published and cover all ten FK areas without inventing weights

edge_cases.description: A failing candidate ignores the FK/CC diagnostic feedback, or a passing candidate expects a numeric score
edge_cases.trigger: the pass/fail-with-feedback reporting model is misunderstood
edge_cases.mitigation: read the FK/CC diagnostic feedback as a restudy heat map on this map; note passers receive no numeric score

edge_cases.description: The Item Development Guide's Figures 1-4 are skipped because they are images, losing the 56-area enumeration
edge_cases.trigger: image-only figures are treated as non-content in a fetch pass
edge_cases.mitigation: explicitly open and read Figures 1-4 (via image/text extraction) in the fetch-enabled pass to capture the verbatim CC areas

workflow.action: Anchor the map to the official 10 FK x 56 CC blueprint
workflow.description: State the Domain of Dentistry matrix shape as FACT and its source documents
workflow.gate: the 10x56 matrix is stated as FACT with the Item Development Guide / Model Domain of Dentistry as its source

workflow.description: Define FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN and the 403-snippet-reconstruction provenance and record official URLs
workflow.gate: every downstream claim carries a FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tag and official URLs are recorded for verification

workflow.action: Enumerate the FK axis and flag the FK weight gap
workflow.description: List FK1-FK10 as [ESTIMATE] and state no per-FK item weighting is published
workflow.gate: FK1-FK10 are listed with the [ESTIMATE] tag and the no-FK-weighting [UNKNOWN] is stated

workflow.action: Structure the CC axis into three groups with counts and weights
workflow.description: Name groups A/B/C with 13/23/20 counts [ESTIMATE], total 56 [FACT], and the ~36/42/22 weights
workflow.gate: the three groups, counts [ESTIMATE], total [FACT] and item-share weights are stated with the count-vs-weight distinction

workflow.action: Map the verified per-group CC content
workflow.description: List the corroborated themes for groups A, B and C as explicit partial [ESTIMATE] reconstructions
workflow.gate: each group's corroborated themes are listed as partial [ESTIMATE] with the unverified remainder flagged

workflow.action: Declare the enumeration gap and its blocker
workflow.description: Carry the [UNKNOWN] on the verbatim 56 CC areas and name the Figures-1-4 + HTTP-403 blocker
workflow.gate: the verbatim-56 [UNKNOWN] is carried with both blockers named, the #1-follow-up status, and no completeness claim

workflow.action: State the integration principle and case-based mode
workflow.description: State every item integrates >=1 FK within a CC and that case sets concentrate the integration
workflow.gate: the FK-in-CC integration is stated as FACT and the case-set chart types are named

workflow.action: Register the official documents and build the official shelf
workflow.description: Record the defining PDFs and assemble the JCNDE/ADA prep shelf as existence [FACT] with the 403 caveat
workflow.gate: the Item Development Guide, Model Domain of Dentistry, Candidate Guide, Technical Report and one-pagers are listed as [FACT for existence] with the 403 caveat

workflow.action: Assemble the secondary shelf and name the resource gaps
workflow.description: List free/secondary resources existence-only and carry the practice-test and video-series [UNKNOWN]s
workflow.gate: secondary resources are existence-only with no endorsement, and the free-official-practice-test and video-series [UNKNOWN]s are named

workflow.action: Wire the feedback loop and the knowledge boundary
workflow.description: State the pass/fail + FK/CC diagnostic feedback remediation loop and the knowledge-only clinical boundary
workflow.gate: the FK/CC diagnostic-feedback remediation use is stated and the INBDE-knowledge-only boundary is drawn

workflow.description: Pair each group's themes and weight with the resource shelf and the feedback loop, flagging the gap
workflow.gate: each CC group is allocated by weight, wired official-first to resources, and the enumeration gap is flagged wherever completeness is implied

workflow.action: Issue the bounded go/no-go and verification backlog
workflow.description: GO for prioritization, NO-GO as an authoritative enumeration, with the binding rules and named backlog
workflow.gate: the verdict gives GO-for-prioritization / NO-GO-as-authoritative, states the binding rules, and names the backlog with the 403/Figures-1-4 blocker

dominance_rules.rule: The enumeration gap dominates any complete-looking CC list
dominance_rules.rationale: the verbatim 56 CC areas could not be extracted (Figures 1-4 images + HTTP 403), so no partial list is the official complete set
dominance_rules.trigger: the per-group CC themes are about to be presented as the complete 56
dominance_rules.action: mark the list partial [ESTIMATE], carry the [UNKNOWN] gap, and defer completeness to a fetch-enabled read

dominance_rules.rule: The official shelf dominates reachable secondary resources on content authority
dominance_rules.rationale: secondary aggregators paraphrase and are reachable but the JCNDE documents are the source of truth
dominance_rules.trigger: a secondary resource is about to be quoted for CC/FK content
dominance_rules.action: cite the official blueprint documents for content and use secondary resources only as existence-flagged corroboration

dominance_rules.rule: A named blocker dominates an invented fact for any [UNKNOWN]
dominance_rules.rationale: the honesty contract forbids inventing areas, FK weights, or resource names to appear complete
dominance_rules.trigger: a gap tempts a fabricated area/weight/channel to fill it
dominance_rules.action: carry the [UNKNOWN] with its named blocker and the verification follow-up instead

dominance_rules.rule: Item-share weights dominate area counts for study-time allocation
dominance_rules.rationale: counts measure coverage breadth while weights measure share of scored items
dominance_rules.trigger: study time is being allocated by CC-area count
dominance_rules.action: allocate time by the ~36/42/22 item-share weights and use counts only for breadth

dominance_rules.rule: Existence-only listing dominates any implied quality endorsement
dominance_rules.rationale: this map makes no accuracy/quality/endorsement claim and several resources are commercial free tiers
dominance_rules.trigger: a resource is about to be recommended as good or authoritative
dominance_rules.action: list it existence-only with the no-endorsement and commercial-free-tier flags

dominance_rules.rule: The knowledge-only boundary dominates any clinical-exam merge
dominance_rules.rationale: the INBDE is a knowledge exam and does not satisfy the separate clinical ADEX/DLOSCE requirement
dominance_rules.trigger: clinical hands-on content is about to enter the map
dominance_rules.action: hold the INBDE boundary and route clinical-exam prep to the clinical/pathway specialists

dominance_rules.rule: A 403 block dominates any non-existence inference
dominance_rules.rationale: an egress-policy 403 means blocked-this-session, not that the document or areas do not exist
dominance_rules.action: record the URL as existing-but-403-blocked and queue it for a fetch-enabled verification pass

dominance_rules.rule: The FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tag dominates a confident summary
dominance_rules.rationale: dropping a tag in summary lets an estimate harden into a claimed fact
dominance_rules.trigger: a claim is being summarized or handed off
dominance_rules.action: carry its provenance tag with it and never upgrade ESTIMATE to FACT without a directly-read official page

anti_rework_rules.rule: Attach the FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tag to every claim when it is first written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an estimate circulating as a fact and having to be retracted from a downstream syllabus

anti_rework_rules.rule: Carry the enumeration-gap [UNKNOWN] alongside every per-group CC list from the outset
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a partial CC reconstruction being rebuilt or corrected after it was mistaken for the complete 56

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the official document URLs and the 403 status in the source registry immediately
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-searching for the blueprint PDFs when a fetch-enabled verification pass becomes possible

anti_rework_rules.rule: Flag every secondary resource existence-only with no quality claim when it is listed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an endorsement being read into the shelf and later having to be walked back

anti_rework_rules.rule: State the count-vs-item-weight distinction the first time both are given
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a spurious 'the numbers don't reconcile' rejection that has to be re-explained

anti_rework_rules.rule: Name the practice-test and video-series [UNKNOWN]s rather than leaving silent gaps
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a fabricated official practice test or an unverified video channel being added and later removed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Draw the knowledge-vs-clinical boundary before wiring the study scaffold
anti_rework_rules.prevents: clinical ADEX/DLOSCE content leaking into the map and having to be unwound

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the Item Development Guide Figures 1-4 explicitly in any fetch-enabled pass
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a verification run that fetches the PDF but skips the image figures and fails to close the enumeration gap

iteration_protocol.trigger: a run with working WebFetch/HTTP to jcnde.ada.org extracts the verbatim 56 CC areas from the Item Development Guide Figures 1-4
iteration_protocol.action: replace the partial per-group themes with the verbatim areas, close the enumeration gap, and flip the authoritative NO-GO to a GO

iteration_protocol.trigger: a directly-read official page confirms the exact FK wording or a published FK/CC item-weight table
iteration_protocol.action: upgrade the FK wording from [ESTIMATE] to [FACT], resolve the FK-weight [UNKNOWN], and re-tune the study allocation

iteration_protocol.trigger: a fetch-enabled read of the Prepare/Apply pages confirms or denies a free official practice test
iteration_protocol.action: resolve the practice-test [UNKNOWN] and update the official resource shelf and the verdict backlog

iteration_protocol.trigger: the B-vs-C group membership of prevention/community items is confirmed against the verbatim list
iteration_protocol.action: resolve the membership uncertainty and firm up the per-group allocation near the boundary

iteration_protocol.trigger: a reputable or official named INBDE video series is fetch-verified
iteration_protocol.action: add the verified series to the secondary shelf existence-only and close the video-series gap

iteration_protocol.trigger: JCNDE publishes a revised Domain of Dentistry or changes the score-report feedback format
iteration_protocol.action: re-anchor the blueprint, the feedback loop and the study scaffold to the revision

priority_rationale: The blueprint, the provenance tagging contract, the FK axis and the three-group CC structure come first because every content and resource decision hangs off the 10x56 matrix and the FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN discipline; the per-group verified themes, the integration principle and the case-based mode next, because they fill the matrix as far as the sources allow; the enumeration gap and the FK-weight, membership, practice-test and video-series gaps are stated explicitly because the KB's honesty rests on naming what could not be verified; the source registry and the official/secondary resource shelves then wire study to materials without endorsing them; and the diagnostic-feedback loop, the study material map and the bounded go/no-go come last because they compose every upstream output into a usable, honestly-bounded study scaffold and verification backlog.
